helpFaqs.question: How do I invite team members to my workspace?
helpFaqs.answer: Navigate to Team Management in the sidebar or Settings page. Click 'Invite User', enter the colleague's email address, select their role (Admin, Editor, or Viewer), and click 'Send Invitation'. They'll receive an email with a link to set up their account. Invitations expire after 7 days.

helpFaqs.question: Where can I download my monthly invoice?
helpFaqs.answer: Go to Settings and select the Billing section. Under 'Invoice History', you'll find a list of all past invoices with download links in PDF format. Invoices are generated on the 1st of each month and retained for 24 months.

helpFaqs.question: What are the rate limits for the API?
helpFaqs.answer: The Analytix Pro API enforces rate limits based on your plan tier. Enterprise plans receive 10,000 requests per minute per API key. If you exceed this limit, the API returns a 429 Too Many Requests response. Contact support to request a limit increase.

helpFaqs.question: How do I configure Single Sign-On (SSO)?
helpFaqs.answer: SSO is available on Enterprise plans. Navigate to Settings > Security > Single Sign-On. You can configure SAML 2.0 or OIDC with your identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace). You'll need your IdP metadata URL and to whitelist our callback URL.

helpFaqs.question: Can I export dashboard data to CSV or Excel?
helpFaqs.answer: Yes. On any dashboard page, click the 'Export' button in the top-right corner. You can export the current view as CSV or schedule automated exports via the Reports page. Scheduled exports can be delivered to email recipients or an S3 bucket.

helpFaqs.question: How does anomaly detection work?
helpFaqs.answer: Analytix Pro monitors your KPIs against a rolling 30-day baseline. When a metric moves more than 15% outside its expected range, the system triggers an in-app alert and optionally an email notification. You can adjust the threshold in Settings > Notifications.
